recommendations.needs_product: Choose Popular products or Recently viewed to use this block outside a product page.

popular.empty: No products to show yet. Pick a collection with products in it, or clear the sold out filter.

collection.needs_collection: Choose a collection above to show its products.
collection.empty: That collection has no products to show. Pick another one, or clear the sold out filter.

recently_viewed.empty: Products a shopper has viewed will appear here. Nothing shows in the theme editor because this preview has no browsing history — and it needs the app embed enabled under Theme settings → App embeds.
